 # Define a regular expression pattern for matching variations of "Honolulu"
 pattern = re.compile(r'Honolulu|Honolulu\s*|\bHonolulu\b', re.IGNORECASE)

 # Apply the pattern to each cell value in the City column and return a boolean indicating if it matches
 def clean_city(value):
     match = pattern.match(value)
     if match:
         return True
     else:
         return False

 # Iterate through the rows and update the City column with the cleaned values
 for row in df['City']:
     df['City'][df.index[row]] = clean_city(row)
return value
